name: courier-mcp
description: Temporary email inboxes for AI agents. Create disposable inboxes, receive OTP codes, extract magic links, and handle verification emails. No signup required.
long_description:
Courier gives AI agents temporary email inboxes that receive real SMTP email. Create an inbox in under 5 seconds, use it for any signup or verification flow, and extract OTP codes, magic links, and verification URLs automatically. No signup, no API keys, no dashboard.

Tools:
- `create_inbox` - Create a disposable email inbox
- `wait_for_email` - Poll until an email arrives
- `extract_otp` - Get verification codes from inbox
- `extract_magic_link` - Get magic links from inbox
- `get_inbox` - Check inbox contents

Perfect for: OTP verification, magic link login, password resets, email confirmation, and any workflow where an agent needs to receive email autonomously.
